<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>שְׁכוּנְתֵּיה דר׳ יוסי וכ׳</he> the quarter in which R. J. the Galilean lived; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>הוות אזלא בכל שְׁכוּנַיָּא ובשכונתיה וכ׳</he> she went begging in all quarters, but in R. Jose’s quarter she did not go; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite> <he>בכל שְׁכוּנֵי דקרתא ובשְׁכוּנֵיה וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 11:3:3">Y. Keth. XI, 34ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שְׁכוּנָה דמשבקי</he> the quarter in which my former husband lives.—Pl. <cite ref="U01134"><he>שְׁכוּנָתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 11:3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לית הכא שְׁכוּנָת חורין וכ׳</he> are there no quarters of other people of the town? <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:10">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite> <he>בכל שְׁכוּנָתָה דקרתא וכ׳</he>, v. supra; a. e.
